description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:236-239 — In the dfs inner loop, spki_der_bytes is called once for the candidate (line 236), but the path-membership check then calls spki_der_bytes again for every cert already in the path (line 238). For a path of depth D, a single dfs frame performs D+1 SPKI DER encodings per pool candidate. Fix: encode the already-in-path SPKIs lazily and cache them, or compare the SubjectPublicKeyInfoOwned directly (it implements PartialEq) without DER roundtrip.
title: spki_der_bytes in path-builder re-encodes candidate SPKI on every path comparison
